subject: Problem with function sem : lavaan ERROR: missing observed variables in dataset:

messages.author: 78129ac2846fc46a
messages.subject: Problem with function sem : lavaan ERROR: missing observed variables in dataset:
parts:
I don't understand why R displays an error. 

My script is : 

read.csv("Resultats.csv")

library(lavaan)
library(semTools)
library(psych)
library(foreign)

psych::describe(Resultats_csv)

urgence<-(Resultats_csv$Urgence)
urgencepositive<-(Resultats_csv$`Urgence positive`)
premeditation<-(Resultats_csv$Premeditation)
perseverance<-(Resultats_csv$Perseverance)
sensation<-(Resultats_csv$`R Sensation`)
punition<-(Resultats_csv$Punition)
recompense<-(Resultats_csv$Recompense)
BES<-(Resultats_csv$BES)
myfas<-(Resultats_csv$Myfas)
BD<-(Resultats_csv$BD)
audit<-(Resultats_csv$Audit)
SPSRQ<-(Resultats_csv$Punition+Resultats_csv$Recompense)
UPPS<-(Resultats_csv$`Urgence positive`+Resultats_csv$Urgence+Resultats_csv$Premeditation+Resultats_csv$Perseverance+Resultats_csv$`R Sensation`)

MODELE='
myfas~UPPS+SPSRQ
audit~UPPS+SPSRQ
BES~UPPS+SPSRQ
BD~UPPS+SPSRQ
UPPS~SPSRQ'


sem(model = MODELE, data = Resultats_csv, std.lv=TRUE)




the error message is as follows: 
Error in lavaan::lavaan(model = MODELE, data = Resultats_csv, model.type = "sem", :                 lavaan ERROR: missing observed variables in dataset: myfas audit UPPS


My variables are well declared (since I can get the descriptive data without any problem) and I have no missing values in my results file.

Maybe a latent/manifest variable declaration problem? I have tried several things and nothing works... Can someone please help me

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: Problem with function sem : lavaan ERROR: missing observed variables in dataset:
parts:
Right after you ran the lines up to " UPPS<-(Resultats_csv ..." and before you call sem() by " sem(model = MODELE, data = Resultats_csv, std.lv=TRUE)", try this:

head(Resultats_csv)

Check whether myfas, audit, and UPPS are in Resultats_csv.

Hope this helps.

Regards,
Shu Fai Cheung (張樹輝)
